answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 23238 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Somebody is not giving my money back me and my husband are very worried.We are facing other problems also.please help me by giving me something to recite. Question: Somebody is not giving my money back me and my husband are very worried.We are facing other problems also.please help me by giving me something to recite. Answer ID: 23238 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1098/888/B=1431) After Isha salah recite Ya Aziz (يا عزيز) 200 times for forty days by sitting while you face towards that person's home and recite durood 3-3 times before and after. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
